caption: The video captures a woman seen from behind in a dance studio, wearing a red sleeveless top and a white fluffy tutu. She wears red leg warmers, red shoes, and a Santa hat, with long dark hair down her back. A mirror wall on the right reflects her every movement under a continuous light strip and ceiling spotlights. Her arms cycle through positions, one extending to the side as the other bends near her head, then both rising overhead before dropping and lifting again. Her torso sways and rotates slightly in sync, alternating between an angled posture and a squarer stance. Weight shifts through her planted feet, heels lifting and knees bending as she holds a wide stance. The motion is continuous, already underway at the start and still ongoing as her arms stay raised.
